name: distribute claude borne work to scripts and lesser models
asks: In this session our goal is to examine where in our stack of business skills and scripts we can start to use 1) scripts for anything we are currently relying on you (claude) for 2) nvidia cloud endpoints for anything we are relying on you for. this'll also help push us toward async work and good context packets. To facilitate this I want to bring a few prior reseearch concepts that are relevant to you, so that these can be most formalized into our systems now: 1) the conceptualization of the quartet of processes, procedures, derviations, and inquiries 2) the conceptualization of LLM agents as actuators in a drone swarm 3) we have prior art on this stuff 4) we cannot expect any LLM to produce well-formed output, but we can expect it to get close. This is a BIG step for our corporate system: moving from one (or a few) user-prompted Claude sessions, toward distributing work out to less-capable models. Part of this will likely be creating smaller offices for smalller duties for smaller skills, so that we can use these smaller models. We're as you can see if you look at git history rapidly iterating toward bootstrapping a swarm of rendanheyi-nodes, each of which has an internal huidu-hull.
